answer: The grove register is checked at draw time, onyx lists the eligible set, and timber seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 243 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
